name: Vietnamese Baked Chicken Wings with Rice, Pickled Veggies & Peanuts

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F). Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes.
While the rice and wings are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rice vinegar
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve radishes lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Peel and mince garlic. Place in another large bowl.
Zest and juice limes into the bowl with the garlic. Add fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup fish sauce
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are almost done, roughly chop peanuts. Add half to the bowl with the pickled veggies and stir once more to combine. (Reserve remaining peanuts for serving.)
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings, rice, and pickled veggies between plates. Top wings with reserved cilantro and peanuts. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed
